svg.text: ATtiny85 speed limiter on the ElectroCookie mini prototype board (top view)
Each half-row of five holes is joined under the board. The wires and the parts are drawn on top.

g.text: Green blocks: one 4P and one 2P from the Aribrnten pack. Pins 1, 2, 5 and 6 of the chip are not used, and the chip stands in an 8-pin socket.
